text: Three studies. (1) Nascent phagosomes lack microbicidal and degradative activity; maturation requires sequential fusion with specialized endocytic and secretory compartments, plus inward/outward vesiculation, tubulation and fission to recycle components and preserve size, yielding phagolysosomes. (2) Capillary electrophoresis with electrochemical detection found catecholamines and metabolites in single lymphocytes and T-/B-cell clones; tyrosine hydroxylase inhibition lowered levels, extracellular dopamine raised intracellular dopamine, and dopamine or L-DOPA dose-dependently inhibited lymphocyte proliferation and differentiation—an autocrine loop down-regulating lymphocyte activity. (3) In mouse small intestine after gamma-irradiation, FGF-2 mRNA and protein rose from 12 h, peaking 48–120 h; the ~24 kDa isoform predominated in mesenchyme surrounding regenerating crypts. Exogenous rhFGF-2 enhanced crypt stem cell survival.
